pr.title: Note that Linux terminals take Ctrl+- before trip sees it
pr.head: 19b843a08b51b7794b1b0ee2d11e00ebe8f094ef

summary: trip runs terminal sessions that keep going after you detach from them. You detach by pressing the detach key, Ctrl-\ by default, and you can pick another key with the TRIP_DETACH_KEY environment variable. The README lists a few example values, one of which is '^-', Ctrl+dash.

The problem is that many terminals use Ctrl+- themselves, to shrink the font, and never send the keystroke on to the program running inside them. Someone who sets TRIP_DETACH_KEY='^-' in such a terminal sees the font shrink and the session stay attached, with nothing saying why.

This pull request adds one short paragraph under the list of examples. It names the Linux terminals that take Ctrl+-, adds that WezTerm takes it on macOS too, and suggests '^]', Ctrl-], instead, the same key the README's mosh section already recommends. The '^-' example stays, because Ghostty, iTerm2, and Terminal on macOS use Cmd+- for the font and pass Ctrl+- through.

groups.title: Warning about Ctrl+- in the README
groups.kicker: A note under the detach key examples
intro: The new paragraph sits right after the code block of TRIP_DETACH_KEY examples, so a reader meets the warning where the '^-' value is first offered. Before this change, the only warning was further down, in the mosh section, where it explains why the mosh example uses '^]'.

files.note: Adds a paragraph under the TRIP_DETACH_KEY examples saying that common Linux terminals, and WezTerm on macOS, take Ctrl+-, and suggesting '^]'.

checks.text: Ghostty's default keybindings on macOS bind super+- (Cmd+-) to decrease_font_size and bind neither ctrl+- nor ctrl+], checked with ghostty +list-keybinds --default. That supports keeping the '^-' example for macOS.

WezTerm's documented default keys bind CTRL - to DecreaseFontSize with no platform qualifier, checked against its default key assignments page, so the note is right that WezTerm takes Ctrl+- on macOS as well as Linux. The second commit added this after the first review suggested it.
